stages.label: DAILY DATA COLLECTION

stages.name: market_analysis
stages.label: MARKET ANALYSIS
stages.description: Regime (HMM + multi-factor DS fusion), regime behavior (size multipliers), sector strength (STRONG-only entry), FII/DII sentiment, correlation (stock/VIX/USDINR), news (cache), economics brain, portfolio health.

stages.name: strategy_optimization
stages.label: STRATEGY + OPTIMIZATION  <-- CURRENT PHASE (paper trading se pehle yahin ho)
stages.when: Admin /optimize (market close ke baad ya weekend)
stages.description: Strategy framework + signal tools (ema_cross, breakout, support_bounce, bollinger_reversion, connors_rsi2, vwap_bounce, rsi_ema, rsi_divergence, volume_divergence, candle_volume, mtf_composite) + PER-STOCK TOOL PARITY (ANY 1..11 SELECTED TOOLS PER STOCK) -> per-stock Bayesian optimization -> per-stock params -> per-phase edge proof (one-sided t-test) -> phase_allow_* flags -> walk-forward validation (WFE) -> RuFlo ranking -> parameter stability.
methods: One-sided t-test per-phase edge proof (alpha=0.10 research convention)

stages.name: validation
stages.label: VALIDATION (backtest + simulation) — admin yahin result dekh ke decide karta hai
stages.description: Full backtest (parity chain R1-R4 = live-identical) -> Monte Carlo DD -> /simulate (admin + subscriber dono dekh sakte hain — candidate strategy ka projection, approval pending label ke saath) -> strategy validator (live vs backtest drift) -> backtest staleness (90 warn / 180 block). v4.1: simulation APPROVAL SE PEHLE — admin result se satisfied ho kar hi agle stage me /deployapprove karega. v4.2 sizing-parity: simulation live jaisi hi scaling pe chalti hai (stage x health x regime) — isliye simulation ka result paper/live ke actual traded amounts se match karta hai.

stages.name: deployment_decision
stages.label: DEPLOYMENT DECISION (simulation result se SATISFIED hone ke baad hi approve)
stages.when: Admin /deployapprove (off-market) — sirf jab /simulate ka result acceptable ho
stages.description: Deployment proposal (WFV-valid only) -> admin simulation result dekh kar approve/reject (/deployapprove /deployreject) -> per_stock_params + optimizer_output + backtest_results commit -> workflow stage gates -> staged capital 10/25/50/100%. v4.1: approval se pehle simulation zaroori — galat decision ka risk khatam.

stages.name: paper_trading
stages.label: PAPER TRADING
stages.description: Scan: universe -> parallel candles -> phase detect -> PHASE GATE (optimization-proven edge) -> per-phase tool signal -> macro filter (FII T-1 -> sector STRONG PIT -> regime fallback) -> dedup -> risk manager 19 checks -> ranking -> sizing -> spread check (order book depth, sirf final candidates) -> paper fill -> GTT forever SL -> monitor 3-min -> daily report -> reconciliation. v4.2 sizing-parity: paper aur live SAME sizing chain (stage x health x regime); har trade me sizing_scale snapshot record hota hai.
methods: Van Tharp velocity circuit breakers + risk budgeting

stages.description: Same chain + real CNC orders + killswitch + reconciliation matrix + TOKEN_INVALID_PAUSE + stage checks.

time_budget_rules: Heavy features (network batch / scrape / model) TRADING WINDOW (09:15-15:30) ke andar kabhi nahi — pre-market (08:00-09:11) ya background + cache.
Scan cycle (5 min) ka total budget <= 3 min — parallel candles + local cache reads only.
Order-book depth sirf ranked final candidates pe, order se turant pehle.
News trade-time me sirf cache read — miss/stale = fail-open (supplementary filter).
Regime trade-time me sirf cache read — cold refresh sirf 09:10 job me.

Universe pipeline: MASTER_STOCK_LIST_PERMANENT.csv is the canonical ~2,158-stock seed; monthly Sharia + owner Board criteria produce CUSTOM_UNIVERSE_FINAL.csv; runtime uses the validated derived universe with fail-closed freshness gates.
Registry: feature_sequence.json master (docs/test isi se derive).
Test: single sequence runner (test_sequence.py) — registry order == test order.
global_goals: Cross-environment alignment: Backtest/Paper/Live share the same decision contract; observed result drift is measured, not used as a blanket AND gate.
